transcribed_question: a) The area shaded blue articulates with be specific b) The area shaded pink is a remnant of? a) Inferior facet corresponding rib b) Notochord

marker.description: Blue paint on the costal facet of the vertebral body

main_question: Identify the structure indicated by the blue paint and state what it articulates with.
main_answer: Costal facet; articulates with the head of the corresponding rib
main_explanation: The blue paint marks a facet on the side of the vertebral body. In a thoracic vertebra, these are costal facets which articulate with the head of a rib.

supporting_question.question: The area shaded pink in the vertebral foramen represents a remnant of which embryological structure?
supporting_question.explanation: The pink area represents the nucleus pulposus of an intervertebral disc, which is a remnant of the notochord.
